name: Honeycomb
tagline: Honeycomb is an observability platform built for high-cardinality debugging of complex distributed systems. Engineering teams use it to explore trace data through ad-hoc queries rather than pre-built dashboards, making it easier to find the specific request or combination of conditions that caused an incident. Its query-first design handles the kind of debugging that traditional metrics systems struggle with when there are millions of possible attribute combinations.
